FINDING (high, test_coverage): The committed Playwright screenshot spec is not runnable because it imports `@playwright/test` but `dashboard/package.json` only declares `playwright`. Evidence: `npx playwright test tests/playwright/architecture.spec.js --list` fails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@playwright/test'`; imports are in `dashboard/playwright.config.js:5` and `dashboard/tests/playwright/architecture.spec.js:10`, while dependencies at `dashboard/package.json:10-14` omit `@playwright/test`. Recommendation: add `@playwright/test` or rewrite the Playwright spec/config to use only the declared local dependency.

FINDING (medium, correctness): Large-graph navigation is incomplete: the UI exposes zoom/reset but no pan, drag, wheel, scroll, or equivalent navigation after zooming. Evidence: `_state.pan` is only read/reset in `dashboard/pages/architecture/architecture.js:243-251`, zoom buttons only change scale at `architecture.js:346-351`, `rg` found no pan/pointer/wheel handlers, and `.arch-explorer-canvas-wrap` uses `overflow: hidden` at `dashboard/pages/architecture/architecture.css:377-383`. Recommendation: add drag/wheel/keyboard pan or scrollable canvas navigation,
